findings.summary: `at_grow` reached buffers the pin had already sized: `new F64(n)` and a growable `[]` bound one type, so every store into `computeNormals`' scratch was a grow-check -- 6,648 in scene 38, none able to fire, at a measured 52-137% penalty on an O(vertices) function, and a semantic difference besides (a typed array DROPS an out-of-range write). The fixed buffer is its own shape now, indexed directly

the cylinder's cone-tip guard read its value back out of the emitted C++ with `parseFloat`, so `{ diameter: 1 - 1 }` walked past it; the record now carries the pin's own `options.diameterTop === 0` question beside the value, which is exact for every spelling and needs no refusal
`createPolyhedron` refused a runtime `flat` and then silently resolved it to `false`, while the emitted body branches on it per build; the flag travels as the record field it is

the emitted `new U32(list)` was a `static_cast`, which is undefined behaviour on a negative double where the pin applies ECMAScript ToUint32; both conversions go through `bbl::js::f32_array_from`/`u32_array_from`

scene 38 linked TWO translations of `computeNormals` and of `createRibbonData` -- one lowered, one hand-transcribed inside the tube; `create_tube` now finishes through `create_ribbon_mesh`, which deletes 205 lines and makes the previously dead `closePath` arm the one the tube uses

`pinned-mesh-defaults` re-implemented four readers that `LoweringContext` and `unwrapPin` already provide, and its fallback search was shape-blind -- it would take the wrong `??` out of an arithmetic default; rewritten on the shared context with one spine walk, plus the boolean reader the polyhedron's `flat` needed
`pinnedFactoryMeshName` existed in three copies; it is one method on `LoweringContext`
`recordComponents` duplicated `lowerObjectComponents`, which also accepts the shorthand property the copy refused

three lookup tables (`LIST_STORAGE`, `ELEMENT_STORAGE`, `ELEMENT_TYPES`) stated one fact three ways; one `LIST_SHAPES` table with three readers, so the declaration path and the expression path cannot disagree
"what does indexing this yield" was written four times; one `elementBinding` answers for the declaration path, the read path, the `length` path and the `push` receiver
the `Vec3` annotation predicate was spelled twice, 540 lines apart; one `isVec3Type`

the ribbon's `pathArray` block re-implemented the tuple/data split of `compileVec3Path` ten lines away, and compiled the same expression twice through an evaluator that has side effects; one `compileVec3PathArray` beside its sibling, one compile
`compileTimeListKinds` restated `handleKinds` verbatim, so a sixth handle kind would silently not join it
the push rule compiled its argument before the cheap kind test, so a data-model `numbers.push(x)` compiled it twice; the pre-check is back for the non-empty case
`declaredListType`'s no-annotation fallback was unreachable and its comment named builders that write no empty literal at all

the polyhedron's option table was deep-copied into its builder where the ribbon beside it already moved; and the ribbon's own first line copied the rows the whole move chain above it had just handed over
`js_data.hpp` was included unconditionally and a second time for a heightmap ground; one include, gated on the two bodies that use it
the file provenance named only the five builders that shipped before this wave; it names every pinned body the unit carries, per feature
an orphaned doc block in runtime.hpp documented a function thirty lines below it
`lowerTube`'s `@param` still described the positional boolean this wave replaced with a feature list
docs/features.md documented a single-path ribbon refusal that does not exist -- that arm is lowered
a TODO line added by this branch duplicated and contradicted the one directly below it, double-counting two scenes the row above already attributed elsewhere
`examples/probes/tup.ts` was a scratch probe committed by mistake; deleted, and its case is a compiler test now

the new compiler and lowering contracts shipped with no test: an anchors case now lowers all four new builders and asserts the flowed defaults, the shared `computeNormals`, the value-selecting `or_number` and the absence of `at_grow` in the fixed buffer, and two compiler tests cover the empty-list push and the cone-tip question
the prvalue heuristic for `std::move` matched on emitted text; it asks whether the value is a bare identifier, which is exactly the case that must move
memoising `getText` in the translator and the pinned-default reads
findings.blockedBy: Measured and refuted rather than blocked: `getText` is 1.12 ms of a 1,549 ms generation (0.07%), and the twenty pinned-default reads are 0.11 ms. There is no cost here to remove, so the caching would be state kept for nothing.
findings.filedIn: This review record, as a measurement that closes the question rather than defers it.
